item.title: fix(doctor): partition retired session stores (#124846)
item.summary: fix(doctor): partition retired session stores (#124846) Recover owner-qualified rows from the retired top-level session store into each configured agent database without guessing ambiguous ownership. Relocate stale transcript paths, tolerate historical Unicode IDs when an explicit transcript exists, and avoid double-counting physical SQLite databases in migration totals.
